## Description {#details}

<p>Templated storage wrapper for a callable.</p>


<p>This class is consistently default constructible, copy / move constructible / assignable.</p>


<p>Supported callable types:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function">Function</a> pointer</li>
<li><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function">Function</a> reference</li>
<li>Lambda</li>
<li><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function">Function</a> object</li>
</ul>

<p>Definition at line 210 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/adt/stlextras-h">STLExtras.h</a>.</p>
